title: Zesty Pink E-Liquid 60ml (3000mg)
description:
Brighten up your day with SupremeCBD’s Zesty Pink CBD E-liquid. Tailored for the bustling lifestyle, our CBD E-liquid is a cinch to use, guaranteeing you your CBD dose with zero fuss. Just load your vape, and you’re all set to savor the vibrant, zesty flavour, wherever life takes you.
Our meticulously crafted blend ensures a silky-smooth vape every time, thanks to the optimal 80% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 20% VG (Vegetable Glycerin) mix. Dive into the tangy pleasure of Red Berries and Lemonade with our Zesty Pink flavour, designed to deliver a delightful vapour cloud that’s as rich in taste as it is in enjoyment.
Our Zesty Pink CBD E-liquid is the ideal choice for those seeking to combine the soothing effects of CBD with the lively, sweet tang of red berries and the refreshing zest of lemonade. Easy to carry in your bag or pocket, it ensures you’re always ready for a relaxing vape session. Give it a try and make your CBD experience a joyful burst of flavour every day!
